#include<bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

struct edge
{
	int y, c, f, cost;
	edge() {};
	edge(int y, int c, int f, int cost) : y(y), c(c), f(f), cost(cost) {};
};

vector<edge> e;

const int N = 14043;
vector<int> g[N];

long long ans = 0;
long long d[N];
int p[N];
int pe[N];
int inq[N];

const long long INF64 = (long long)(1e18);

int s = N - 2;
int t = N - 1;

int rem(int x)
{
	return e[x].c - e[x].f;
}

void push_flow()
{
	for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) d[i] = INF64, p[i] = -1, pe[i] = -1, inq[i] = 0;
	d[s] = 0;
	queue<int> q;
	q.append(s)
	inq[s] = 1
	while q:
		int k = q.popleft()
		inq[k] = 0
		for x in g[k]:
			if not rem(x): continue
			int c = e[x].cost
			int y = e[x].y
			if d[y] > d[k] + c:
				d[y] = d[k] + c
				p[y] = k
				pe[y] = x
				if inq[y] == 0:
					inq[y] = 1
					q.append(y)
		cur = t
	while cur != s:
		e[pe[cur]].f += 1
		e[pe[cur] ^ 1].f -= 1
		cur = p[cur]
	ans += d[t]
}

def add_edge(x, y, c, cost):
	g[x].append(len(e))
	e.append(edge(y, c, 0, cost))
	g[y].append(len(e))
	e.append(edge(x, 0, 0, -cost))

def main():
	n, m, k, c, d = map(int, input().split())
	for i in range(k):
		x = int(input()) - 1
		add_edge(s, x, 1, 0)
	tt = 101
	for i in range(tt):
		add_edge(0 + i * n, t, k, i * c)
	for i in range(m):
		x, y = map(int, input().split())
		x, y = x - 1, y - 1
		for i in range(tt - 1):
			for j in range(k):
				add_edge(x + i * n, y + i * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1))
		for i in range(tt - 1):
			for j in range(k):
				add_edge(y + i * n, x + i * n + n, 1, d * (j * 2 + 1))
	for i in range(n):
		for j in range(tt - 1):
			add_edge(i + j * n, i + j * n + n, k, 0)
	for i in range(k):
		push_flow()
	print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
	main()
